summary: Well-structured workflow and module with comprehensive error handling, semantic exit codes, and clear separation of concerns. Best practices throughout: pinned actions (checkout@v4), least-privilege permissions (contents: read), Set-StrictMode, parameter validation, proper exit codes (0/1/2), semantic errors to stderr. Minor issues: markdown and JSON validation steps each invoke the script independently, duplicating classification work; PowerShell version check step is redundant (pwsh pre-installed). No breaking issues; production-ready.
